card.name: UK workplace safety and scattered words
card.fires_on: Mostly small words inside UK health-and-safety duty statements ("employers are responsible for ensuring the", "duty of employers is to"). Also partway through foreign or titled names like Hydrobiologie, Feed-in Tariff and Demokratische.
